pr_title: Add EV charging remote services for BMW/Mini
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
This PR adds up to three `select` entities to `bmw_connected_drive`, all related to controlling EV charging.
If an entity is created in Home Assistant depends on the capability of the vehicle (the information is parsed by the library).

When a new value is selected, the respective remote service is triggered through the library to the BMW API.

To be able to add tests for this, I had to update the fixtures and also switched to the new snapshot for diagnostics (added a new vehicle, so had to rework the fixture for diagnostics anyway).

Library release notes: 
  - https://github.com/bimmerconnected/bimmer_connected/releases/tag/0.12.2
  - https://github.com/bimmerconnected/bimmer_connected/releases/tag/0.12.3
  - https://github.com/bimmerconnected/bimmer_connected/releases/tag/0.13.0

issue_context.title: Unable to use charge feature with Mini Cooper SE
issue_context.body:
### The problem

With my Mini Cooper SE (EV vehicle) I can't use the charging remote command.
Looking at the code, it would be possible to have the "Charge now" feature active but it is not the case.

Very sad for an EV vehicle.
May be this vehicle is not totally recognize.

Because I'm also a developer in Home Assistant, I can help to test this feature with a real Mini car if this is needed.

The only control I have are the following and there is nothing for charging:
![Capture d’écran 2023-03-18 à 07 53 02](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1712374/226090301-5715c8d6-ca8c-4eb7-bfe3-97a499fdd35d.png)

The button to start charging was added some time ago but never really worked.
You'll need a vehicle with at least ID8 infotainment (so only i4/i7/iX at the moment) to actually charge directly. Thats a limitation on BMW API/vehicle side.

However, with https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/85255 you'll be able to control charging by setting a charging window and then either set the vehicle to charge only during the window or charge immediately.
Ok fine. Thank you for your time

review_comments: Why is this not represented by a number entity with min 20, max 100, stepsize 1?

We need step size 5 as the API doesn't accept anything in between.
I wasn't able to do that with number steps somehow.
One to keep in mind for a future PR: this should be moved out of `init.py` into `entity.py`
